$comment: Model output schema for document extraction, sent in strict structured-output mode. It mirrors SubmissionRequest in openapi/quote-api.yaml, flattened, with every field nullable so the model can say 'not in the document' instead of guessing. Strict mode needs every property listed in required and additionalProperties false; formats are checked by ExtractionResponseParser, not here. ExtractionSchemaContractTest keeps this in step with the API contract.

businessName.description: Legal name of the insured (not a DBA or trade name, not the broker).

address.description: The insured's risk location, never the broker's address.

line2.description: Suite, unit or floor, if any.

region.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. PA.

annualRevenue.description: Annual gross revenue in USD as a plain decimal string with no symbols or commas, e.g. 1850000.00.

perOccurrenceLimit.description: Each-occurrence GL limit in USD as a plain decimal string, e.g. 1000000.00.

aggregateLimit.description: General aggregate GL limit in USD as a plain decimal string, e.g. 2000000.00.

effectiveDate.description: Requested policy effective date as yyyy-MM-dd.

flags.description: Fields a human reviewer should check.

field.description: A field name from this schema (address parts as address.city), or 'document'.

note.description: One short sentence for the reviewer.

evidence.description: For each non-null field, the short passage of the document it came from.

sourceText.description: Copied from the document, at most about 120 characters.
